standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-barronite.npc: You there! Seek out the centurion at once. Inform him that the enemy leader has been identified and the Carnifex Maximus himself has been dispatched to bring back his head!
Did you not hear me? Do I need to spell it out for you?

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-barronite.player: If you could that would be great.

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-barronite.npc: Goodness you are a fool! Their leader is named Yonrith Lovakengj. He has fled to the west with his closest allies, but much of his army still remains. Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis is in pursuit of him.

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-barronite.player: Yeah... I still have no idea what you're on about.

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-barronite.npc: Useless! Perhaps the headsman needs to take your head as well. I will find the centurion myself!

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-bank-area.npc: Ah, there you are. Dire news I'm afraid. We've lost all contact with the capital. Worse, another dwarven clan has joined the Saradominists. They march upon the fortress as we speak.
Is everything all right my friend? You don't seem to be yourself.

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-bank-area.player: I don't think I'm who you believe I am.

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-bank-area.npc: Hmm. You're clearly confused. The lack of sleep is getting to you. Go and have a lie down and we will discuss this later.

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-chaos-gol.npc: I've been doing some research into our new foes. Rumour has it they once lived in a great city in the far north. The city fell and now they are homeless.
It seems they have been promised a new home here in return for wiping us out. We must take great care. We may be fighting for our home, but it seems they are as well.

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-chaos-gol.player: Right... And err, how's the fight going so far?

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-chaos-gol.npc: You tell me, I'm no warrior. That said, I did hear that they'd managed to turn some of our own golems against us. If they can do that, I fear what else they may do.

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-chaos-gol.player: Oh my... That doesn't sound good...

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-chaos-gol.npc: Indeed. We have increased our offerings tenfold, but I fear they fall on empty ears. Perhaps our lord really has gone.

standard-dialogue-ghost-at-the-chaos-gol.player: Hmm. Well I hope it all works out.
